requirements.description: original DUT manufacturer, serial, physical challenge identity
independent reference identity, certificate, issuer registry and expiry
independent bench identity, certificate, issuer registry and expiry
independent human-verified physical origin for DUT, REF, BENCH, shared-ancestry resolution
original unmodified acquisition bytes, sample counter, SHA-256 and clock provenance
same-path physical injection and output measurement
original drift and alarm traces with calibrated timebase
traceable uncertainty budget and declared decision tolerances

logic: deny if any required field missing; structured completeness is not authentication; external credential, ancestry and original-sample verification required for qualification review
simulated_tests: not an instrument test; no new empirical dataset
separation: software intake completeness != real physical provenance != operational permission
